matrix.consumer_expectation: All provider and consumer contracts needed for compatibility review are available.
matrix.provider_guarantee: Review runner found required provider contracts, specialized payload contracts and consumer draft contracts.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Provider and consumer schemas compile before compatibility is asserted.
matrix.provider_guarantee: Hardened provider contracts and consumer draft schemas compile under Draft 2020-12.

matrix.consumer_expectation: StateResolutionRequest is a common provider envelope with one specialized payload.
matrix.provider_guarantee: Provider contract declares common envelope plus market_state_request/event_state_request specialized payloads and if/then coupling.
matrix.notes: StateResolutionRequest is not an alternative third scientific request authority.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Each state request type resolves exactly one promoted runtime capability.
matrix.provider_guarantee: Runtime capability registry snapshot provides symmetric Market State and Event State capability identities.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Event State v0.1 admits only session_opened with exchange_session subject scope.
matrix.provider_guarantee: Provider payload schema constrains event_type_ids to session_opened and event_subject_scope to exchange_session.
matrix.notes: halt_resumed remains unsupported and must be blocked by the interface.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Consumer cannot submit source, parquet, registry or output paths.
matrix.provider_guarantee: StateResolutionRequest requires allow_physical_path_input=false and bans known path/implementation keys in specialized payloads.
matrix.notes: Recursive forbidden-key scan remains a required non-schema runtime validator.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Market State and Event State expose common resolution decisions.
matrix.notes: No free-form accepted status remains in the hardened response contract.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Backtest may request Market State, Event State, or both without ambiguous bundle semantics.
matrix.provider_guarantee: StateBundleManifest supports market_state_only, event_state_only and market_and_event with one aggregate bundle sealing multiple request fingerprints.
matrix.notes: Consumer may still also process one bundle per state kind; aggregate mode is the provider canonical option.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Consumer can distinguish partial validated candidate evidence from full request satisfaction.
matrix.provider_guarantee: StateBundleManifest requires requested/represented/unavailable/blocked/quarantined/unaccounted counts and declares code validation for arithmetic equality.
matrix.notes: JSON Schema enforces shape; runtime validator must enforce requested = represented + unavailable + blocked + quarantined + unaccounted.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Backtest StateReplayFeed opens only for official/downstream-authorized state datasets.
matrix.provider_guarantee: Provider continues to return candidate references only: official_dataset=false, downstream=false, physical_rows_delivered=false.
matrix.notes: This is a compatibility finding, not a consumption authorization. Consumer DRAFT status remains.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Backtest declares state needs and references provider contracts without rebuilding states.
matrix.provider_guarantee: BacktestRunSpec references provider-owned StateResolutionRequest and StateBundleManifest and keeps state consumption optional.
matrix.notes: Consumer must be revised later to include RuntimeInvocationResponse and EffectiveCapabilityView hashes before DRAFT can be removed.

matrix.consumer_expectation: Valid request does not imply execution or row delivery.
matrix.provider_guarantee: StateResolutionRequest separates validate, resolve and invoke modes and requires allow_new_candidate_execution=false in v0.1.
matrix.notes: A future bounded interface execution authorization is still required before invoking runtime behavior.

required_future_consumer_updates_before_: Seal provider contract hashes in BacktestInputManifest, not only contract IDs and versions.
Add separate evidence of backtest consumption authorization before StateReplayFeed can open.
Map StateBundleManifest aggregate cardinality explicitly in RunPreflight implementation.
